name: stri_trans_list
title: List available text transforms and transliterators

origin.details: The ids are sorted with locale en_US, numeric collation, and strength 1. Each id can be passed to stri_trans_general.
origin.example:
ids <- stri_trans_list()
cat(paste0("stri_trans_list() returns ", length(ids), " transforms and starts with ", ids[[1]], ".\n"))

translation.details: The ids come from Transliterator.getAvailableIDs. They are stable-sorted with an en_US collator at primary strength and numeric collation, which is how stri_sort is called in R.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.trans import stri_trans_list
ids = stri_trans_list()
print(f"stri_trans_list() returns {len(ids)} transforms and starts with {ids[0]}.")
